summary: A legal-heavy day with important judicial pronouncements on police conduct and regulatory matters, alongside significant retail sector developments including a major jewelry acquisition and Reliance's IPO regulatory clearance.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court rules police cannot selectively arrest accused; must follow consistent procedures regardless of status.
GRT Jewellers to acquire significant stake in Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri for $109 million, reshaping jewelry retail landscape.
Jio Platforms receives regulatory approval for $3.8 billion IPO from India's markets regulator.
Delhi High Court rejects PIL challenging homeless persons' eligibility for Slum Rehabilitation Scheme coverage.
Zomato restructures customer support operations, laying off 250 employees as part of operational efficiency drive.
